actual_about_text: PeaZip release: 11.4.0 - Linux Build, AARCH64, GTK2
environment: Ubuntu 24.04 arm64; GTK2 2.24.33; Xvfb X11; no window manager; root user; Noto CJK fonts
capture_method: ImageMagick import -window WINDOW_ID; actual client size 1024x600 and 1440x900; client-only screenshots without window manager decorations
states: sample.7z archive root (docs folder and other.txt)
double-click docs folder (empty, nested, 你好.txt)
ZIP creation panel: ZIP / Normal / New archive / Single volume, do not split; cancelled without creating archive
reproduce: Use the verified asset_url and the recorded capture_steps. The automated replay under target/linux-ui-baseline/reproduced had occlusion and is not the canonical capture.
limitations: GTK2 portable upstream baseline, not Rust GTK4 rewrite
No desktop window manager decorations or desktop-native picker coverage
Known upstream TControl.ChangeBounds diagnostics retained in logs; no observed launch or archive listing failure
The released binary matches version 11.4.0; binary build provenance does not prove it was built from the exact pinned source commit.
capture_note: Canonical six images manually inspected without tooltips. Automated reproduced/ run had an occlusion artifact in docs and is diagnostic only.
capture_steps: Original upstream PeaZip 11.4.0 Linux ARM64 GTK2 portable baseline.
Downloaded official asset URL and matched SHA256 recorded in provenance.json.
Container: peazip-linux-runtime-20261108-a; /src read-only.
Extracted upstream archive to /work/original; installed GTK2 runtime inside container only.
Started Xvfb 1440x900x24 using xvfb-run -a and dbus-run-session.
Started original executable with /work/original/empty (PID 199, window 2097246).
xdotool windowmove WINDOW 0 0 windowsize --sync WINDOW 1024 600
import -window WINDOW 1024x600-empty.png
Resized to 1440 900 and captured 1440x900-empty.png.
Started same upstream executable /src/tests/fixtures/sample.7z (PID 288, window 4194398).
Captured archive root at both sizes using the same windowsize/import commands.
At window origin 0,0 double-clicked docs row: xdotool mousemove 300 155 click --repeat 2 --delay 150 1.
Opened Help > About (menu 425,13, item 460,320) and captured about.png, visibly confirming release 11.4.0 AARCH64 GTK2.
Closed About with Cancel (1380,875 at 1440x900), clicked blank list area (800,500) to dismiss stale hint.
Captured docs at 1440x900, resized to 1024x600, clicked blank area and captured again.
Canonical six root PNGs were each visually inspected; reproduced/ diagnostic attempt had occlusion and is NOT canonical.
Screenshots contain actual upstream client area, without window-manager decorations. No image repaint/compositing.

create_zip_normal_capture.ui_kind: Original Add/Archive creation panel in the main Lazarus GTK2 window; not a separate GtkDialog

theme.resource_note: Graphics/theme are embedded in the released binary; see peazip-sources/res/share/themes/main-embedded/readme.txt
theme.gtk: Default GTK2 widget styling; no GTK_THEME/GTK2_RC_FILES override applied

create_zip_normal_capture.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 arm64; GTK2 2.24.33; Xvfb X11; no window manager; root user; Noto CJK fonts
capture_steps: Inspect existing canonical PNGs/provenance and reuse cached PeaZip 11.4.0 LINUX.GTK2.aarch64 binary; no download.
Copy the cached portable directory inside the same owned container to /work/original/create-reference/portable for isolated settings.
Start that executable on /work/original/create-reference/input using Xvfb 1440x900x24 and dbus-run-session, English locale, no window manager.
Create only the input reference.txt (41 bytes); record its SHA256 before opening the application.
At 1024x600 client size select reference.txt and click toolbar Add. The original main window switches to its Archive creation panel.

ZIP is selected; change the cached Level value Fast to Normal using the dropdown. Keep New archive and Single volume, do not split. Leave additional options unchecked; do not enter a password/keyfile.
Move pointer outside the client and resize to expose/repaint. Capture the actual window with ImageMagick import -window WINDOW_ID at 1024x600 and 1440x900.
At 1440x900 click Cancel (1380,875), returning to the file manager. Never activate OK.
Verify original reference.txt SHA256 unchanged, reference.zip absent, and the input directory still contains exactly one regular file.
coordinate_steps_1024x600: Select reference.txt at (265,155), click Add at (52,49).
Open Level dropdown at (490,439), select Normal at (275,460).
Move pointer to (1439,899); resize briefly to 1024x601 then 1024x600 to expose/repaint.
Resize the same window to 1440x900; import -window WINDOW_ID 1440x900-create-zip-normal.png
Click Cancel at (1380,875); verify input hash and absence of reference.zip.
